name: Basket Service
description: Manages shopping baskets for customers; publishes checkout events to trigger order creation and handles inventory updates

endpoints.name: mark-product-unavailable
endpoints.description: Marks a product as unavailable in all open baskets when stock is depleted

endpoints.name: initiate-checkout
endpoints.description: Initiates checkout for a basket with shipping address; emits CheckoutInitiated event containing all order details for downstream order-service and fulfillment-service

endpoints.name: create-basket
endpoints.description: Creates a new shopping basket for a customer; emits BasketCreated event

endpoints.name: clear-basket
endpoints.description: Clears a basket after successful order creation; matches basket via referenceId

endpoints.name: list-baskets
endpoints.description: Lists all baskets (demo endpoint; returns in-memory state)

endpoints.name: get-basket
endpoints.description: Returns basket contents including item availability status

endpoints.name: add-item
endpoints.description: Adds a product to the shopping basket; emits ItemAdded event

endpoints.name: remove-item
endpoints.description: Removes a product from the shopping basket; emits ItemRemoved event

events.description: Emitted when a customer creates a new shopping basket
Emitted when a customer initiates checkout; contains all order details including shipping address to enable order-service and fulfillment-service integration
Emitted when a product is added to a shopping basket
Emitted when a product is removed from a shopping basket
